test_resolve_channel_prompt_by_id: test the DiscordAdapter._resolve_channel_prompt method to match a prompt by channel ID
test_resolve_channel_prompt_by_parent: test the DiscordAdapter._resolve_channel_prompt method to inherit a prompt from a parent channel ID
test_exact_channel_overrides_parent: test that an exact channel prompt overrides a parent channel prompt in DiscordAdapter
test_thread_session_inherits_parent_prom: test that a thread session inherits the parent channel prompt via _dispatch_thread_session
test_retry_preserves_channel_prompt: test that the _handle_retry_command preserves the channel_prompt on the retried MessageEvent
